scientific_target: Model-conditioned tissue-FA ambiguity supported by explicit low-discrepancy parameter witnesses on one real diffusion acquisition
claim_type: paper-derived descriptive method and sensitivity case; not exact cohort replication
independent_unit: one acquisition; ROI voxels are dependent descriptive locations, not independent subjects

data.bank_use: metadata inspected only; source signal convenience cache may be reused only after independent provenance validation; old fitted parameter banks are not ground truth

preprocessing.basis: Freeze legacy mask, gradient orientation, smoothing and proxy-ROI construction only; do not inherit old optimizer or point-matching tolerances
preprocessing.required_release_action: Export and hash a preprocessing-only contract to avoid accidentally importing obsolete fitting rules

model.f_semantics: effective free-water signal fraction, not independently measured CSF volume
model.S0: positive fitted parameter; normalize discrepancy by measured b0
model.tensor_validity: positive semidefinite, nonzero tensor; no post-hoc eigenvalue clipping
model.solver: unrestricted provided numerical evidence satisfies the public contract

secondary_single_shell.decision: pending bounded pilot; protocol-specific operational sensitivity only; mean-SSE sets need not nest and found lower bounds do not establish interval contraction

b3500.role: not used in v1 primary or holdout scoring
b3500.reason: high-b non-Gaussian model mismatch is a separate question

discrepancy.interpretation: deterministic signal-space discrepancy, not likelihood or confidence level
discrepancy.constraint: ceilings must be independently qualified and fixed before model evaluation; neither agent-declared bad fits nor model performance may set them

parameter_domain.decision: RELEASE BLOCKER: justify bounds scientifically and run sensitivity before freezing them; f approaching one leaves arbitrarily little tissue signal, so witness ambiguity can be boundary-driven and must not be called bound-independent

search_requirements.no_witness_semantics: search lower bound unresolved; not a uniqueness or identifiability certificate
search_requirements.anti_vacuity: No-work or insufficient fit/profile evidence fails; a complete qualified search honestly returning no_witness_found on every row is permitted. Do not force positive ambiguity or mistake search failure for uniqueness.

scoring.status: not designed or calibrated for release

resource_contract.this_turn: source-free arithmetic unit tests and source-bank shape inspection only

proposed_pilot.selection: 16 midpoints of equal index bins after lexicographic sorting of the frozen ROI; no selection on old errors or new fit outcomes
proposed_pilot.profile_grid: freeze after parameter-domain review, before fitting
proposed_pilot.source_access: authenticated cache read-only; no original output mutation
proposed_pilot.stop: provenance failure or resource/fit cap; never stop on a desired ambiguity pattern

release_blockers: Justify and freeze parameter domain; retain boundary/degenerate-case interpretation
Qualify explicit arithmetic tolerances for PSD rotation/representation stability and released rounded gradient norms; do not silently clip or renormalize
Approve bounded source-data pilot and deterministic selection before inspecting redesign outcomes
Qualify public discrepancy and fit/profile-quality budgets with independent numerical implementations
Choose complete-evidence requirement that rejects no-work disclaimers without pretending search failure proves uniqueness
Export preprocessing-only public contract and audit source-cache lineage
Publish exact output schemas and scoring semantics; implement source-bound verifier
Run in-container oracle plus negative controls before fresh blinded frontier calibration
